runtime.interaction: Computer Use on a visible Windows Electron development window

startup.reason: The Electron development window was already open before observation.

routeNavigation.entry: Command palette search followed by Return
routeNavigation.boundary: From Return-key dispatch until a Computer Use screenshot and accessibility state showed the JSON minify page.
routeNavigation.result: The page loaded and displayed its existing sample input and output.

exit.reason: The window existed before this test and was left open.

packagedBuildAttempt.target: A new temporary Windows x64 unpacked directory outside the repository.
packagedBuildAttempt.observation: electron-builder reached packaging but produced no output files for more than three minutes.
packagedBuildAttempt.cleanup: The build process was stopped. The existing release/win-unpacked directory was not changed.

limitations: The route timing is one development-window sample. It includes Computer Use screenshot capture and is not comparable to the automated production baseline.
This observation does not establish packaged startup or exit performance.
The TOML sample input was cleared and the application returned to its home route after the check.
